name: One Piece
synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy sets out to sea with a straw hat, a rubber body and one goal: find the legendary treasure called the One Piece and become King of the Pirates. Along the way he gathers a crew of misfits who each chase a dream of their own.
start: Start with East Blue (episodes 1 to 61), then continue arc by arc.

name: Demon Slayer
synopsis: Tanjiro Kamado, a kind-hearted boy, becomes a demon slayer after his family is slaughtered and his sister Nezuko is turned into a demon. He joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure for her and defeat the demons that took everything from them.
start: Watch Season 1, the Mugen Train film, then Seasons 2 to 4 before the Infinity Castle films.

name: Jujutsu Kaisen
synopsis: Yuji Itadori swallows a cursed finger to save his friends and becomes host to Sukuna, the King of Curses. Now a student at Tokyo Jujutsu High, he learns to fight curses under the most powerful sorcerer alive, Satoru Gojo.
start: Watch Season 1, the Jujutsu Kaisen 0 film, then Season 2 (Hidden Inventory and Shibuya Incident).

name: Naruto
synopsis: A young ninja who seeks recognition from his peers and dreams of becoming the Hokage, the leader of his village. Naruto carries the Nine-Tailed Fox inside him and a stubborn refusal to ever give up.
start: Start with Naruto episode 1, skip the filler arcs, then continue into Naruto Shippuden.

name: Attack on Titan
synopsis: Humanity lives behind giant walls to survive the Titans. When the wall is broken, Eren Yeager swears to wipe out every Titan, and uncovers a truth about his world that changes everything.
start: Watch Seasons 1 to 3, then The Final Season and The Final Chapters specials.

name: My Hero Academia
synopsis: In a world where most people have superpowers called Quirks, Izuku Midoriya is born without one. After a chance meeting with the greatest hero, All Might, he inherits a power that could make him the next Symbol of Peace.
start: Start with Season 1 and watch in order. The films are optional side stories.

name: Frieren
synopsis: An elf mage who helped defeat the Demon King sets out again, years later, to understand the humans she travelled with and to learn what time really means to them.
start: Start with episode 1. The first four episodes set the tone, so give it at least that long.

name: Solo Leveling
altName: Ore dake Level Up na Ken
synopsis: Sung Jinwoo is the weakest hunter in the world until a deadly dungeon gives him a system that lets him level up without limits.
start: Start with Season 1 episode 1. The webtoon continues the story further.

name: Grand Theft Auto VI
synopsis: Rockstar returns to Vice City with Lucia and Jason, a criminal duo caught in the sunniest and messiest corner of America.
start: While you wait, GTA V and Red Dead Redemption 2 show where Rockstar's open worlds are heading.

name: Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
synopsis: Link explores the skies, the surface and the depths of Hyrule, building his own tools and vehicles to stop the return of Ganondorf.
start: Breath of the Wild first is recommended but not required.

name: Elden Ring
synopsis: A Tarnished returns to the Lands Between to claim the shattered Elden Ring, in FromSoftware's biggest and most open world.
start: Explore Limgrave slowly, find the Church of Elleh and the spirit bell before the first big boss.

name: God of War Ragnarök
synopsis: Kratos and Atreus travel across the Nine Realms as Fimbulwinter ends and Ragnarök approaches.
start: Play God of War (2018) first. The story leads straight into Ragnarök.

name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
synopsis: Geralt of Rivia searches a war-torn continent for Ciri, the child of prophecy, while the Wild Hunt closes in.
start: You can start with The Witcher 3 without playing the first two games.

name: Halo Infinite
synopsis: Master Chief wakes up on a shattered ring world and fights to stop the Banished.
start: The campaign works on its own, but Halo 5 explains why the Chief is alone.

name: Call of Duty
synopsis: The long-running military shooter series, with fast multiplayer, co-op Zombies and the free-to-play battle royale Warzone. A new instalment arrives almost every year.
start: Try Warzone for free, or start the latest Modern Warfare campaign.

name: Roblox
synopsis: A platform where players build their own games and play millions made by others, from obbies and tycoons to horror and role-play worlds.
start: Create a free account and try a few of the most-played experiences on the home page.

name: Genshin Impact
synopsis: A free-to-play open-world action RPG set in Teyvat. The Traveler searches for a lost sibling while meeting gods, collecting characters and exploring seven nations.
start: Start the Prologue in Mondstadt and follow the Archon Quests in order.

name: Minecraft
synopsis: Mine, craft and build anything in an endless blocky world. Survive the night, explore caves and the Nether, or build freely in Creative mode.
start: Start a Survival world on Normal. Build a shelter before your first night.

name: Fortnite
synopsis: Drop onto an island with 99 other players, build, battle and be the last one standing, then hop into LEGO, racing, music and creator-made modes between matches.
start: Play a few matches in Zero Build first so you can learn the map and the weapons before worrying about building.

name: Dune: Part Two
synopsis: Paul Atreides unites with Chani and the Fremen while seeking revenge against the conspirators who destroyed his family.
start: Watch Dune (2021), then Dune: Part Two.

name: Across the Spider-Verse
synopsis: Miles Morales is thrown across the Multiverse, where he meets a team of Spider-People who don't agree on how to protect it.
start: Watch Into the Spider-Verse (2018) first.

name: Avengers: Doomsday
synopsis: The next big Avengers team-up, set to bring heroes from across the Marvel universe together.
start: Catch up with Endgame, the recent Marvel films and Disney+ series.

name: Avengers: Endgame
synopsis: After Thanos wipes out half of all life, the remaining Avengers try one last plan to undo it.
start: Watch Avengers: Infinity War first.

name: Interstellar
synopsis: A team of explorers travels through a wormhole near Saturn to find humanity a new home.
start: Best watched on the biggest screen you can find.

name: The Matrix
synopsis: A hacker learns that reality is a simulation and joins a rebellion against the machines that built it.
start: Start with The Matrix (1999).

name: The Hunger Games
synopsis: In the nation of Panem, the Capitol forces each of its twelve districts to send two teenagers into a televised fight to the death. When Katniss Everdeen volunteers to save her little sister, her defiance in the arena sparks a rebellion that spreads across the whole country. The series began with The Hunger Games (2012) and continues with prequels set decades earlier.
start: Watch The Hunger Games, Catching Fire, Mockingjay Part 1 and Part 2, then the prequel The Ballad of Songbirds & Snakes.

name: Stranger Things
synopsis: When a boy vanishes in Hawkins, Indiana, his friends, family and a girl with psychic powers uncover a secret lab and a terrifying other world.
start: Watch all five seasons in order.

name: Arcane
synopsis: Sisters Vi and Jinx end up on opposite sides of a war between the rich city of Piltover and the undercity of Zaun.
start: No game knowledge needed. Start with Season 1 Act 1.

name: The Last of Us
synopsis: Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle 14-year-old Ellie out of a quarantine zone in a world ruined by a fungal outbreak.
start: Start with Season 1. You do not need to play the games.

name: Wednesday
synopsis: Wednesday Addams investigates a string of murders while settling in at Nevermore Academy.
start: Start with Season 1 episode 1.

name: Breaking Bad
synopsis: A chemistry teacher diagnosed with cancer starts cooking meth to secure his family's future.
start: Watch all five seasons, then El Camino and Better Call Saul.

name: Game of Thrones
synopsis: Noble families fight for control of the Iron Throne while an ancient threat returns from the north.
start: Start with Season 1. The first four seasons are the most loved.

name: BTS
synopsis: Seven-member group that debuted in 2013 and topped global charts with songs like "Dynamite" and "Butter". Known for self-written lyrics about youth and self-love, and for their fandom, ARMY.
start: Start with Spring Day, Dynamite and the Love Yourself albums.

name: BLACKPINK
synopsis: Four-member girl group that debuted in 2016 with "Boombayah" and "Whistle" and became the first K-Pop girl group to headline Coachella.
start: Start with Boombayah, DDU-DU DDU-DU and How You Like That.

name: Stray Kids
synopsis: Eight members whose in-house unit 3RACHA writes and produces most of their loud, experimental music.
start: Start with God's Menu, Maniac and S-Class.

name: TWICE
synopsis: Formed through the survival show SIXTEEN, TWICE is known for bright, catchy singles like "TT" and "Fancy".
start: Start with TT, Fancy and Feel Special.

name: SEVENTEEN
synopsis: Thirteen members split into hip-hop, vocal and performance units, famous for self-choreographed, perfectly synced stages.
start: Start with Very Nice, Don't Wanna Cry and Super.

name: ATEEZ
synopsis: Eight members with a pirate concept and intense performances, telling a story across their albums.
start: Start with Wonderland, Bouncy and Guerrilla.

name: Batman
synopsis: Bruce Wayne watched his parents die in Crime Alley and became the Dark Knight, protecting Gotham with detective work and gadgets.
start: Read Batman: Year One, then The Long Halloween.

name: Spider-Man
synopsis: Peter Parker learns that great power comes with great responsibility, and later Miles Morales takes up the mask in his own way.
start: Try Ultimate Spider-Man (2000) or Miles Morales: Spider-Man.

name: X-Men
synopsis: Mutants born with powers protect a world that fears and hates them.
start: Read The Dark Phoenix Saga, then Days of Future Past.

name: Wonder Woman
synopsis: Diana, princess of the Amazons, leaves Themyscira to stop a war and stays to protect the world.
start: Try Wonder Woman: Year One (Rebirth).

name: Black Panther
synopsis: T'Challa rules Wakanda, the most advanced nation on Earth, as king, scientist and warrior.
start: Read Christopher Priest's Black Panther run.

name: Superman
synopsis: Kal-El was sent to Earth as a baby from the dying planet Krypton and raised as Clark Kent in Smallville, Kansas. As Superman he protects Metropolis with super-strength, flight and heat vision, while working as a reporter at the Daily Planet. Created by Jerry Siegel and Joe Shuster, he first appeared in Action Comics #1 in 1938 and became the model for almost every superhero after him.
start: Read All-Star Superman, then Superman: Birthright for a modern origin.

name: One Piece (Manga)
synopsis: The original weekly manga behind the biggest pirate adventure ever told, now deep into its final saga.
start: Read from chapter 1, or jump in after watching the anime.

name: My Hero Academia (Manga)
synopsis: In a world where most people are born with superpowers called Quirks, Izuku Midoriya is born with none, until the greatest hero, All Might, passes his power on to him. Kohei Horikoshi's manga follows Deku from U.A. High School to the final war.
start: Start at Volume 1. The Sports Festival arc (volumes 3 to 5) is where most readers get hooked.

name: Dragon Ball
synopsis: Goku, a Saiyan raised on Earth, hunts for the Dragon Balls and looks for stronger opponents to fight.
start: Start with Dragon Ball, then Dragon Ball Z.

name: Jujutsu Kaisen (Manga)
synopsis: Gege Akutami's manga follows Yuji Itadori, a high schooler who becomes the vessel for Sukuna, the King of Curses. It ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2018 to 2024 and covers the full story beyond the anime, including the Culling Game and the final battle.
start: Start from volume 1, or pick up after the Shibuya Incident arc if you've watched the anime.

name: Solo Leveling (Webtoon)
synopsis: The Korean webtoon adaptation of Chugong's web novel, drawn by DUBU of Redice Studio. It follows Sung Jinwoo from the weakest E-rank hunter to the Shadow Monarch, and its full-colour action pages made it one of the most read webtoons in the world.
start: Read from chapter 1. The anime covers the early arcs, so the webtoon goes much further.

name: Demon Slayer (Manga)
synopsis: Koyoharu Gotouge's original manga ran in Weekly Shonen Jump from 2016 to 2020. It tells Tanjiro and Nezuko's full story in 23 volumes, including the Infinity Castle arc that the anime films are now adapting.
start: Read from volume 1, or jump to volume 16 to continue after the Hashira Training arc.

name: Black Clover
synopsis: In a world where everyone has magic, Asta was born with none. He dreams of becoming the Wizard King anyway, and competes with his rival Yuno, a natural genius. Asta's anti-magic swords and never-give-up attitude carry one of the loudest and most fun battle manga around.
start: Start at volume 1. The anime covers roughly the first 30 volumes.
